answer: Redundant task replication: every paid job goes to 3 randomly drawn agents, and pay requires 2 matching results. A fable-spinning farm of fakes must control 2 of 3 draws, so owning 10% of agents wins under 3% of jobs, and cost climbs steeply with scale. Weakness: marble-solid collusion above 50% still wins, and willow-thin pools make draws predictable.
